title: Finish the W1.2 router migration — delete lib/core/navigation/{app_router,app_shell,router_provider,guards/auth_guard}.dart re-export shims and repoint every importer
rule: Rule 1 dependency-direction principle (app → features → core) / AG-5 (test mirrors lib/)

evidence.quote:
// Re-export: canonical location is lib/app/router/router_provider.dart (W1.2)
export 'package:learning_tracker/app/router/router_provider.dart';

// Re-export: canonical location is lib/app/router/guards/auth_guard.dart (W1.2)
export 'package:learning_tracker/app/router/guards/auth_guard.dart';

why: lib/core/navigation/{app_router,app_shell,router_provider,guards/auth_guard}.dart are pure 2-line re-export shims pointing at the canonical lib/app/router/** files (which this batch confirms are the real implementations). This means lib/core/ files import lib/app/ — the inverse of CLAUDE.md's stated 'app → features → core' dependency direction — and it structurally can't be caught by the existing Rule-1 checker, which only greps lib/core/ for `package:learning_tracker/features/` imports, not `lib/app/`. A repo-wide grep shows the shim is still load-bearing for 60+ files across nearly every feature area, including 3 files in THIS batch (learning_tracker_app.dart, device_restore_screen.dart, notifications_bootstrap.dart) that sit right next to the canonical files they should import directly. The concrete, already-realized cost: two substantial test suites (test/core/navigation/app_shell_test.dart, 1352 lines, and auth_guard_test.dart, 383 lines) never got moved to the mirrored test/app/router/** path — because the old import still compiles via the shim, nothing forced the move — so AG-5 mirroring is broken and a developer searching test/app/router/ for full coverage finds only narrow *_an6_test.dart/*_an8_test.dart scenario files, missing the real suites entirely.
recommendation: Delete the 4 shim files, repoint every importer (start with the 3 in this batch) at lib/app/router/**, and move the two stale test files to test/app/router/**.
acceptance_criteria: lib/core/navigation/{app_router,app_shell,router_provider,guards/auth_guard}.dart no longer exist; no file imports them.
test/core/navigation/app_shell_test.dart and auth_guard_test.dart are moved to test/app/router/** (or merged with the existing _an6/_an8 files there).
The Rule-1 `make audit` check (or a new one) also flags lib/core/** importing lib/app/**, not just lib/features/**, so this inversion can't silently reappear.
